title: The Light, Our Bastion
wikitext:
[[File:The Light, Our Bastion.png|thumb|The Light, Our Bastion]]

'''The Light, Our Bastion''' is a book that can be found outside the [[Scarlet Citadel]] in [[Tirisfal Glades]].

{{Book|content=
The Light, it is our protector within these decrepit and plagued lands, once so full of life and beauty has now been reduced to decay. We are a torch within the darkness, and the Light is what holds it back. It is the shining example of what was, and what will be in the new Lordaeron that we will create in its path. The Paladins and the Priests of our order wield its greatness with devastating effect, as many brother and sister has seen.

It is within the Light we should place our hopes, our prayers, and our trust.
----
A beacon that connected the creation of this order, and still keeps us together now, even after so much hardship, and trial. Despite how many times we have come close to ruin, and despite the fall of the kingdom around us we stand firm.

Should the time come when darkness encroaches,
----
remember that the Light always shines through you, and your sacrifice will be repaid fully in the Light's graces.

The Light does not forsake, the Light does not forget. Let us forever keep it at our hearts. No matter how dark the world is, the Light will always shine again.

~Scribe Dafoldt
}}
